text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, I accompanied Ikuno Dictus
to a party hosted by the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for inviting me to such a wonderful party today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I have made thorough preparations
to liven up the party.
Please leave the support to me...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah... umm...
Today is, well... a tea party...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry...!
If only I had explained it properly...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, simply enjoying black tea on its own
is quite enjoyable as well.
Thank you for your consideration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
T-That simply will not do!
I cannot allow our guests to suffer such misfortune!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is it!
Let us have a special event... A game!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm here! We're playing games, right!?
What is it, what are we playing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: To put it simply, it's "Guess Who I Am?"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Everyone submits a prompt, one person draws one, and then everyone asks that person questions—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, so the person who drew it answers
with 'yes' and 'no', and everyone else
tries to guess the prompt, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Now that I've said it aloud, hearing it calmly makes it sound rather plain...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You never know until you try.
Besides, aren't you curious to see how it goes?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Who will be the fastest to deduce the answer...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whew! Nice, that gets me fired up!
In that case, the more the merrier, right?!
I'll go call the others over!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Will you be using that in a race?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...The answer is 'no.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "Yes."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (The pause before denying it means they debated whether to use it in a race...? If that's the case—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Do you use it during training?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "Yes."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, I know! A dumbbell!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Splendid... although, isn't this the very prompt that you put in yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~! But you don't know
which one is coming, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's true! But still, Ikuno,
you always cut straight to the core with your questions!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And with that, it's Ikuno's turn
to be the contestant!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I want to show her that
we can do it even without her around!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, understood.
Now then, for the prompt—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The game continued to heat up after that, bringing the party to a roaringly successful close.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for today.
It has been quite a while since I enjoyed such a lively tea party!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No. The one who suggested playing a game
was McQueen-san.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Wanting to entertain me. Not wanting to disappoint me.
It was because I felt those thoughts of yours that I became even more motivated."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No way...! You were the one who made my plain little game so exciting, Ikuno-san...
choice_data_list: Let's give the credit to the two of them.
We had fun... isn't that enough?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I have no objections, but
what about you, McQueen-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No... not at all!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I'd be thrilled if you invited me again when you have the chance!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satisfied with her visit,
Ikuno Dictus departed the Mejiro estate.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, quite.
In any case, thank you very much.
It was a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Likewise!
Please come visit us together again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to come again..."
It was such a delightful party that it left that very impression.
